summary: FleetCare iter 8 tested (both). Backend pytest 17/17 pass (test_iteration8.py). Frontend Playwright: login, /strategia (season banner, simulator until+need_auto=1+need_furgone=0 → total_saving computed, tabs suggestions/plan, save plan from suggestion → plan-item appears, plan-delete works, export excel/pdf buttons present), /manutenzione (controlli matrix 5 rows, interventi add/complete/delete flow, stats apply + total cost card), /impostazioni (strategy-target-auto/furgone/altro, strategy-alert-month-select 12 options, strategy-alert-send-now, maint-types-list with 7 defaults + add + delete). Costo collaudo persists on create/update; undo restores prior costo. Suspension plan lifecycle (planned→applied→vehicle.policy.status=suspended). Simulator surplus flag: with need_auto=1 and eligible autos, top-scoring eligible items become level='high' with 'Sospendi (eccedenza)'. Reports return correct content-types (Excel spreadsheetml, PDF %PDF header). Alert send-now returns JSON with sent/reason. Maintenance overview switches control state from 'never' to 'ok/upcoming' with next_due=checked_at+interval. Notifications/today includes 'manutenzione' events for overdue controls. Permission 'manage_maintenance' labeled 'Manutenzione e controlli periodici'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2152 lines — long-standing recommendation to split into modules (strategy, maintenance, reports).
Deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still used (FastAPI ≥0.109 recommends lifespan handler).
latest_checks_map() loads up to 50k check docs into memory each overview/notifications call; consider an aggregation pipeline or per-vehicle latest lookup as data grows.
compute_strategy is called from many endpoints (reports, alert, plan display) — recomputes each call; fine for small fleets but cache-friendly if fleet grows.
Notifications 'manutenzione' events don't check bell_days consistency separately from other events — OK but overdue always shown.
